दो गिलास निवाया पानी। वार्म वाटर आपको पीना है। वार्म वाटर पीने के बाद बारी आएगी ब्रेकफास्ट की जो पूरे दिन की हमारी सबसेेंट मील होती है। अगर आपने ब्रेकफास्ट बढ़िया कर लिया तो आपका वेट गेन 50% तो ईजीली हो जाएगा। ब्रेकफास्ट में क्या खाना है? ब्रेकफास्ट में आपको या तो ओट्स खाने हैं या दलिया लेना है। उसमें दूध डाल देना है 250 ml और उसमें काजू, बादाम, किशमिश या मूंगफली इनमें से कोई भी चीजें डाल देनी है। जो भी आप डालना चाहो उससे क्या होगा? उस खाने की कैलोरीज बढ़ जाएगी। उसमें हेल्दी फैट बढ़ जाएगा। जो आपका सोसोन भी बढ़ाएगा, आपकी बॉडी भी तगड़ी करेगा। और अगर आप वेजिटेरियन हो तो आप सुबह टोफू या सोया चंक्स में से कुछ भी ले सकते हो। 100 ग्राम आपका टोफू होना चाहिए या 50 ग्राम सोया चंग्स। अगर आप नॉन वेजिटेरियन हो तो चार अंडों की ऑमलेट ऑमलेट बना के खानी है आपको घी या बटर में। यह हो गया आपका ब्रेकफास्ट जो सबसे जरूरी था। फिर बारी आएगी लंच की। और लंच में आपको क्या खाना है? बहुत सारे राइस, चावल, सफेद चावल जितना हो सके खाओ भाई। किसके साथ? दाल के साथ। क्योंकि जब आप दाल के साथ चावल खाओगे तो वो एक कंप्लीट प्रोटीन सोर्स बन जाएगा जो आपको बहुत ही ज्यादा हेल्प करेगा वेट गेन करने में। अगर आपको डाइजेशन की दिक्कत आती है तो साथ में आप खीरा रख सकते हो या कोई भी सैलेड रख सकते हो ताकि आपका डाइजेशन भी अच्छे से इंप्रूव हो। आपको फाइबर भी मिल जाए। लंच के बाद बारी आएगी स्नैक्स की। स्नैक्स हमारी वो मील होती है ना तो हमें बहुत हैवी खाना है ना बहुत लाइट खाना है। और स्नैक्स में लोग क्या खाते हैं? नमकीन, बिस्किट, चिप्स, मोमोज खा लिए। अरे भाई ये स्नैक्स थोड़ी होता है यार। ये आपके पेट को तबाह कर देगा ये चीजें। आपको क्या खाना है स्नैक्स में? अगर वेट गेन करना चाहते हो इस दुनिया का सबसे बढ़िया कार्बोहाइड्रेट का सोर्स आलू। आलू से बढ़िया चीज नहीं है वेट बढ़ाने के लिए, मास बढ़ाने के लिए। पर अगर आप आलू को ही गलत तरीके से खाओगे तो वेट नहीं बढ़ेगा। ठीक है? आपको क्या करना है? आलू को बॉईल करना है। कुकर में लगा दी उसमें सीटी। आपने कर लिए दो से तीन आलू बॉईल और आपने ली 250 ग्राम दही और आपने उसमें मिला दिया आलू में और बढ़िया सा मसाला डाला चाट मसाला चिक और मतलब गया ना अंदर आपको यह मील तगड़ा कर देगी मैं गारंटी देता हूं ये स्नैक्स आपको रखना ही रखना है इसके अलावा आपका कोई स्नैक्स नहीं होना चाहिए यह आपकी फिक्स रहेगी मील स्नैक्स आपका कंप्लीट हो गया है अगर आप जिम जाते हो तो स्नैक्स ही आपकी प्री वर्कआउट मील होगी आप आलू और दही खा के जिम जा सकते हो और 45 मिनट बाद अपना वर्कआउट स्टार्ट कर देना। जब आप वर्कआउट करोगे तो आपको 1 लीटर पानी पीना है पूरे वर्कआउट के दौरान। तो पोस्ट वर्कआउट के लिए मैं आपको तीन ऑप्शन दे रहा हूं जो बेस्ट है। आप कोई भी चूज़ कर सकते हो। या तो आप 150 ग्राम पनीर और दो केले खाओ। या तो आप चार बॉईल अंडे और दो केले खाओ और या तो आप एक स्कूप वे प्रोटीन और दो केले खाओ। अकेले आपको खाने हैं पनीर, अंडे और वे प्रोटीन में से आप कुछ भी ऑप्शन चूज़ कर सकते हो। जो मैंने पोस्ट वर्कआउट में आपको तीनों ऑप्शन बताए तीनों चीजों में प्रोटीन है। प्रोटीन सबसे इंपॉर्टेंट न्यूट्रिएंट है। प्रोटीन भाई मतलब आपको खाना ही चाहिए। एक इंसान की ग्रोथ के लिए बहुत जरूरी है। आपकी बॉडी कैसे ग्रो कर रही है? आपकी मसल कैसे ग्रो कर रही है? आपकी ओवरऑल ग्रोथ कैसी है? आपका टेस्टोस्टरॉन कैसा है? ये सारा डिपेंड करता है प्रोटीन पर। और लोगों में प्रोटीन की बहुत ज्यादा कमी है। प्रोटीन आपको पनीर से मिल रहा है, सोया चंग से मिल रहा है, टोफू से मिल रहा है, अंडे से मिल रहा है। एक बढ़िया प्रोटीन सप्लीमेंट से लो। प्रोटीन सप्लीमेंट बनता कैसे है? दूध से, दूध की जब सारी इंप्योरिटीज हटा दी जाती है जब जाके एक बढ़िया वे प्रोटीन बनता है। पर मार्केट में बहुत सारे वे प्रोटीन है। ठीक है? बढ़िया ही लेना। ₹500 ज्यादा लग जाएंगे। बट वो काम आएगा आपकी बॉडी के। आपकी ग्रोथ के लिए। आप आप नहीं अपने घर में जितने भी लोग हैं सबको प्रोटीन पिलाओ भाई। क्योंकि प्रोटीन की कमी बहुत ज्यादा लोगों में। और जब बात आती है प्रोटीन की हमेशा चूज़ करो एक बढ़िया क्वालिटी का प्रोटीन जैसे मैं यूज़ करता हूं पिछले डेढ़ साल से माय प्रोटीन के सारे सप्लीमेंट्स माय प्रोटीन इस दुनिया की बेस्ट ब्रांड है दुनिया की इंडिया में तो है ही दुनिया भर में माय प्रोटीन क्वालिटी के लिए बेस्ट है और जब बात आती है प्रोटीन की माय प्रोटीन का इंपैक्ट वे एक बहुत बढ़िया प्रोटीन है जिसका प्राइस भी बहुत बढ़िया है और आपको क्वालिटी तो बेस्ट मिलेगी ही मेरा कोड यूज़ करोगे रोहित 07 आपको मिलेगा एक्स्ट्रा डिस्काउंट डिस्क्रिप्शन में लिंक है जाके माय प्रोटीन का इंपैक्ट वे प्रोटीन कोई भी फ्लेवर ले लेना कैवेंटर से ले लेना। मेरा डे डिलाइट बहुत बढ़िया लगता है मेरे को। ठीक है? आप जो भी बढ़िया लगे पर एक बढ़िया प्रोटीन सप्लीमेंट अपनी डाइट में ऐड करो। अब बारी आती है डिनर की। डिनर में आपको क्या खाना है? डिनर में आपको वो चीज खानी है जो आपने पूरे दिन में खाई है ना उसमें से कोई भी ऑप्शन ले सकते हो। रोटी, चावल या आलू। ये तीन चीजें वेट बढ़ाने के लिए बेस्ट है। बट दिक्कत क्या है? title: What the Tudors REALLY ate – and why it was healthier than you think
tags: ["history", "history podcast", "history extra", "british history", "ukhistory", "history documentary", "world history", "interview", "learning", "historian", "medieval", "Tudor food", "tudors food", "historic food", "food history", "Ruth Goodman", "tudor life"]
transcript: The beginnings of a major change are happening here, and it's going to reach out and change the British diet forever. [Music] Hello, I'm Ruth Goodman, and we're going to be talking today about Tudor food and drink. From rich stews and fresh baked bread to preserved meats and porridge, Tudor food was shaped by the seasons and by social status. We'll find out what a typical day's diet looked like from breakfast through to supper, and we'll discover why Tudor food wasn't quite as unhealthy as you might first assume. [Music] Probably the most important food for any Tudor was bread, but by bread we often mean quite a range of things. Now, obviously, we'd expect there to be a loaf of bread, such as you might buy from an artisanal bake shop these days, and if you look here in our Tudor kitchen, you can see the oven where it was baked. But, it didn't just mean that. The word bread covered quite a range of different styles of thing. And if you're in North Wales, such as we are today, many people were eating not that sort of baked in an oven bread, but rather oatcakes, as you can see up on this creel up here. So, these are drying in front of the fire. They're cooked on a griddle. If you can't afford an oven, and if your grain is oat rather than wheat, because the weather here doesn't always ripen the wheat, you'll find the same in many upland areas of Britain, then oats are better done as a flat cake rather than trying to turn them into a traditional bread. They don't make very good bread, and of course not everybody's got an oven. So, if you are in one of these upland areas in Wales, Scotland, the Pennines, wherever it might be, cooking on a open fire, and having to manage with oats as your main grain, oatcakes were the solution. You make a sort of like porridge, and then you sort of spread it out on a flat bake stone. So, once you've had them on your bake stone, and you've done them on both sides, then you stand them up in some sort of frame to dry out. And in that way, you can keep them and keep them and keep them. It's one of the great advantages of oatcakes. They keep so well, and don't go stale like a loaf of bread does. In some areas, you get a sort of mix, part loaf of bread, part oatcake, things like bannocks, jannocks in another area of the country. It's It's quite a varied tradition of different sorts of breads, different sorts of oatcakes, different sorts of barley bread, rye bread, all mixed together, and every region had its own specialities. There wasn't one standard bread across Britain. But, it was the thing that most people ate most often. For many people, it was their main food, breakfast, dinner, and supper. But, even for the very wealthy, it formed the the the basis upon which everything else built. This is a time, remember, before potatoes, before there was widespread rice, before there was pasta. So, that first flush of milk, when the grass is first springing up and is lush and green, well, that milk is very high in fat, which makes it extremely good for butter making. So, butter is a sort of spring and early summer thing, unless you salt it. So, it tastes different later in the year. Fresh butter in the spring, salted butter later on. So, whilst that early flush of grass made very fatty milk, very creamy milk, later in the summer, the the milk contains more caseins, and that makes it perfect for cheese making. So, early spring, you'd make lots of butter, and then you'd only start to make your cheese once the spring really got going. So, maybe not till June, and then you'd cheese make through the rest of the year. So, there are seasons to your dairy produce. Same with your eggs. The chickens don't lay when there's low light levels. Um they're they're sparked into laying by the pituitary gland, which notices how much daylight there is. Now, in a modern world, we put them in sheds, and we give them artificial light so that they'll lay all the year round. But, that's not possible in Tudor England. So, too, are meats. If you think about it, it doesn't make sense to kill a cow if she's in calf. So, Easter, for example, was the time for lamb. If you had a spare lamb, or one that wasn't looking too good, and you decided that one's going to go, that's the moment you would eat it. Minha vida tá maravilhosa. Fica com ele. Logo depois que ele me contou isso,

para emagrecer, ele falhava. Toda vez. E agora chegaram as canetas. Então me responde: por que agora seria diferente? O PONTO DE VIRADA E agora silêncio, porque aqui vem o ponto crucial. O que nenhum laboratório quer que eu

força de vontade. É no cérebro. Cientistas descobriram a leptina, 
que é um hormônio que a gordura   produz para avisar o cérebro: 
Chega de comer, estou satisfeito. O problema: pessoas obesas têm muita leptina 
no sangue, mas o cérebro não escuta. É como   gritar para alguém usando um fone de ouvido 
no máximo. O sinal existe, mas não chega. Sabe o que é a mesma coisa?

no sangue, só que as células não ouvem,   têm resistência. A mesma lógica. O hormônio 
existe, mas o corpo parou de responder. E aí entra o GLP-1, um hormônio que seu próprio 
intestino produz toda vez que você come. Ele faz três coisas:
1. Avisa o pâncreas para liberar insulina  2. Avisa o estômago para esvaziar mais devagar
3. Avisa o cérebro que você está satisfeito A METÁFORA Agora guarda essa imagem porque 
isso aqui é a metáfora que vai   fazer você entender tudo sem precisar ser médico. As anfetaminas eram como

para emagrecer, mas destrói a casa junto. Já o GLP-1 é o oposto. GLP-1 é como ajustar o termostato. Você não está quebrando nada, você está regulando

exatamente a hora de apagar a luz. Não é um estimulante, é um hormônio que seu corpo   já produz naturalmente. A caneta só 
aumenta a quantidade desse sinal. Pela primeira vez, não estamos 
forçando o corpo a fazer algo que   ele não quer. Estamos ajudando ele 
a fazer o que ele já deveria fazer. OS DADOS POSITIVOS Então, funciona? Funciona. Funciona até demais. E aqui que entram os dados positivos que 
fizeram os cientistas arregalarem os olhos. CÂNCER Outubro de 2025, JAMA Oncology, uma das 
revistas mais respeitadas do mundo de oncologia. Um estudo gigante: 86.000 pacientes analisados,   metade usava GLP-1, metade não 
usava, acompanhados por anos. Resultado: quem usava GLP-1 tinha 
17% menos risco de desenvolver   câncer. Não só um tipo — 14 
tipos de câncer diferentes. Câncer de ovário: 47% menos  Câncer de endométrio: 25% menos

veio de outro estudo logo a seguir. MORTALIDADE POR CÂNCER DE CÓLON Novembro de 2025, Universidade 
da Califórnia, San Diego. Quase 7.000 pacientes com câncer de cólon e 
obesidade analisados. Compararam quem usava   GLP-1 com quem não usava. Acompanharam por 5 anos. A mortalidade foi de 15% para quem usava 
GLP-1, mas 37% para quem não usava. 62% menos chance de morrer. Não é 
de ter câncer — de morrer de câncer. E por quê? Lembra da fábrica de inflamação que eu expliquei? 
A inflamação crônica é combustível para câncer.   GLP-1 reduz gordura, reduz 
inflamação e talvez tire o   combustível que o tumor precisa para crescer. A DESCOBERTA ACIDENTAL E agora vem a parte acidental que eu te 
falei. A descoberta que ninguém esperava. Pessoas começaram a perder a 
vontade de beber álcool sem querer. Não era objetivo do tratamento. Não 
estava na bula, mas pacientes reportavam. Eu tive paciente que falou: Doutor, esse remédio 
salvou meu casamento, eu estava alcoólatra. Agora a gente tem um estudo sueco 
de 227.000 pessoas analisadas. Quem usava semaglutida — que 
é o Ozempic, o Wegovy — tinha   36% menos hospitalizações por problemas de álcool. Sabe quanto os remédios específicos 
para alcoolismo reduziram? Zero. Remédio para emagrecer funcionou melhor 
que os remédios para parar de beber. Por quê? Porque o cérebro que controla 
fome é o mesmo circuito que controla a   recompensa, o impulso, o prazer 
— inclusive o prazer do álcool. MAIS BENEFÍCIOS Parece bom demais para ser verdade, né? Ah, Mounjaro. Na bula do Mounjaro diz

vai ficar à noite com CPAP? Além disso, Mounjaro e Ozempic reduzem gordura no   fígado. Reduzem seu risco de ficar com 
cirrose por causa de gordura no fígado. CORAÇÃO - MINHA ESPECIALIDADE Ah, e coração — minha especialidade. Metanálise gigante, JACC, 2025. 
Quase 100.000 pacientes analisados,   21 estudos no total. A maior revisão 
já feita sobre essas canetas. O resultado? 12% menos morte por qualquer causa  15% menos risco de infarto
15% menos insuficiência cardíaca E não é só para diabético. 
Funciona em quem tem obesidade,   em quem tem problema renal, 
em quem tem coração fraco. RESUMO DOS BENEFÍCIOS Então, some tudo:
1. Diabetes: controla a glicose, melhora a   resistência à insulina, reduz hemoglobina glicada
2. Coração: menos infarto, menos insuficiência   cardíaca, menos morte cardiovascular

7. Sono: melhora a apneia do sono  8. Peso: não porque força, porque regula o 
sinal de saciedade que seu corpo já tinha OS RISCOS Agora vem o outro lado da moeda,   porque se eu não te contar os riscos, 
eu estou sendo desonesto com você. PROBLEMAS DE VISÃO Lembra do Robbie Williams que eu te 
falei no começo? Ele não é o único. O que está acontecendo com 
ele tem explicação científica. Existe uma condição chamada neuropatia 
óptica isquêmica anterior. Em português:   o nervo do olho para de 
receber sangue adequadamente. Um estudo de Harvard encontrou que os 
usuários de semaglutida podem ter duas   a quatro vezes mais risco dessa condição, 
principalmente no primeiro ano de uso. É raro? Sim, cerca de um a 
cada 10.000 por ano de uso. Mas pensa comigo: um risco baixo multiplicado 
por milhões de usuários vira um número grande. O QUE MAIS ME PREOCUPA COMO MÉDICO Só que o que mais me preocupa como médico não é só   isso. É o que eu mesmo vi 
acontecer no consultório. GLP-1 retarda o esvaziamento do estômago. 
Isso é parte de como ele funciona,   mas isso pode afetar a absorção 
de remédios que a pessoa toma. Eu tive um paciente epilético 
controlado há anos. Começou a   caneta para emagrecer e voltou a ter convulsões. Por quê? O anticonvulsivante que tomava todo dia 
começou a ser absorvido de forma errática.   Remédio que deveria manter um nível estável

remédio para afinar o sangue há anos,   nunca teve trombose desde que começou. Começou a caneta. Meses depois, um episódio

de volta ao seu peso inicial. Agora me responde uma coisa. Você pergunta pro hipertenso se ele vai

de muleta. Não é ciência, é preconceito. A DIFERENÇA Então, quando eu vejo um paciente

eu tô comendo dois pedaços de pizza. Eu penso: Esse cara não pode parar de tomar 
remédio porque ele vai voltar a comer. Agora, se a pessoa fala: Doutor,

da injeção para dar aquele   empurrãozinho e o cérebro ouvir melhor a leptina. As canetas são a salvação ou o desastre? Nem um nem outro. Elas são a primeira vez na

[සංගීතය] ඔන්න හිතන්න ඔයා දැන් දවල්ට කාලා ඉවර වුණා විතරයි. ඊළඟ පැය හතර ඇතුලත ඔයාගේ ශරීරය මේ කාපු කෑම ටික දිරවන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. එතකොට ඔයාගේ රුධිරියට එකතු වෙන සීනි මට්ටම ඉහලා යනවා. එතකොට ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම ඉහලා යනවා. ඔයාගේ ශරීරය මෙන්න මේ රුධිරියට එකතු වුණු සීනි ශක්තිය බවට පරිවර්තනය කරගන්නවා. මේ පැය හතරේදී සිද්ධ වෙන්නේ ඔයා අහපු කෑම ටික දිරවන එක. [සංගීතය] ඔන්න දැන් ඔයා දවල්ට කාලා පැය හතරකට පස්සේ. ඒ කියන්නේ ඊළඟ පැය හතර. හතරවෙනි පැය ඉඳලා අටවෙනි පැය දක්වා කාලය. මේ කාලය ඇතුලතදී ඔයා ආපු කෑම ටිකේ එහම් පිහිටීම වගේ දිරවලා ඉවරයි. දැන් ඔයාගේ ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම ටිකෙන් ටික පහළ වැටෙන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. ඔන්න දැන් ඔයාගේ අක්මාව ග්ලයිකෝජන් මුදාහරින්න පටන් ගන්නවා. ග්ලයිකෝජන් කියන්නේ ඔයා අර කාපු කෑම වලින් ගවඩා කරපු ග්ලුකෝස් ටික. මෙන්න මේක සිද්ධ වෙන්න පටන් ගන්නකොටම ඔයාට ආයෙමත් බඩ ගින්නක් දැනෙන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. ඔන්න දැන් ආමාෂ බිත්ති වලින් ග්‍රේලින් කියන හෝමෝනේ මුදා හර. මේ ග්‍රේලින් ඔයාගේ මොලයට සනල් එකක් දෙනවා ඔයාගේ බඩ හිස් වෙලා තියෙන්නේ දැන් ඔයා කෑම කන්න වෙලාව හරි කියලා. මෙන්න මේක නිසා තමයි ඔයාට බඩ ගින්න දැනෙන්නේ. [සංගීතය] දැන් ඔයා දවල්ට කාලා පැයා අටක් ගත වෙලා ඉවරයි. මෙන්න මේ කාලේදී තමයි පළවෙනි මැජික් එක සිද්ධ වෙන්නේ. ඊළඟ පැය හතර ඇතුලත. ඒ කියන්නේ ඔයා කෑම කාල ඉවර වෙලා අටවෙනි පැය ඉඳලා දොස්වෙනි පැය වෙනකම් කාලය ඇතුලත ඔයාගේ ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම සැලකිය යුතු පහලලා බහිනවා. අර කලින් ආපු කෑම වලින් ගබඩා කරගත්තු ග්ලයිකෝජන් ටික ඉවර වෙන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. ග්ලයිකෝජන් ටික ඉවර වෙනකොට ඔයාගේ ශරීරය දහනය කරන්න අවශ්‍ය තව ඉන්ධනයක් හොයනවා. මොකද ඔයාගේ ශරීරයට ශක්තිය ලබාගන්න අවශ්‍යයි. මේ කාලය ඇතුල් තිබෙදී ඔයාගේ මනස හොඳ පැහැදිලි මට්ටමක තියෙනවා. අවධානය ටිකක් විතර තීවුර වෙනවා. ශරීර ශක්තිය බොහොම සමතුලිතව තියෙනවා. [සංගීතය] ඔන්න දැන් ඔයා දවලට කාලා පැය 12ක් ගත වෙලා ඉවරයි. දැන් ඔයා කලින් ගබඩා කරගත්තු ග්ලයිකෝජන් ටික ඔක්කොම ඉවරයි. දැන් ඔයාගේ ශරීරය ඔයාගේ මේ දේ දහන කරන්න පටන් අරගෙන තියෙන්නේ. හිතන්නකෝ එයා දවලට කෑවේ දවල් එකට විතර කියලා. ඒ කියන්නේ දැන් වෙලාව රෑ එකට විතර ඇති. මේ විද්‍යුයාගේ ශරීරය වේගයෙන් මේදේ දානය කරගෙන යනවා. ඔයාගේ ශරීරයේ ගබඩ වෙලා තිබුණු මේද අම්ල අක්මාවට ගමන් කරනවා. අක්මාව මේද අම්ල කීටෝන බවට පත් කරනවා. කීටෝන ඔයාගේ මොලයට අවශ්‍ය කරන ශක්තිය ලබා දෙනවා. මේ වෙලාවේදී ඔයාගේ ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම වැටෙන්න පුළුවන් පහළම මට්ටමට වැටිලා තියෙන්නේ. මෙන්න මේ මොහොත ඔයාගේ ශරීරයට ගොඩක් වැදගත් බලගතු අවස්ථාවක්. මේ වෙලාවේදී ඔයාගේ ශරීරයේ තියෙන නිදාගත්තුක්නින් සර්වස් එක නැගෙට ඉන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. මේකට අපි කියන්නේ ඕටෝ පැජි කියලා. මෙන්න මේ ඕටෝපැජි කියන ඔයාගේ අභ්‍යන්තර ක්ලීනින් සිස්ටම් එක ඔයාට ගොඩක් වැදගත්. දැන් මෙන්න මේ වෙලාවේදී ඔයාගේ ශරීරයේ තියෙන ඩැමේජ් වුණු සෛල අලුතින් ප්‍රතිනිර්මාණය කරන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. ඒ වගේම ඊළඟට තවත් මැජික් එකක් සිද්ධ වෙනවා. ඒක තමයි ඔයාගේ තියෙන වර්ධක හෝමෝන වැඩි වෙන්න පටන් ගන්නේ එක. මේ වරදක හෝමෝනේ තමයි ඔයාව වයසට යන එක පාලනය කරන්නේ. සාමාන්‍යයෙන් ඔයා වැඩිවියට පත් වෙන කාලේදී තමයි මේ වර්ධක හෝමෝනය ඔයාගේ උපරිම වට්ටමේ තියෙන්නේ. ඊට පස්සේ මේක ටිකෙන් ටික අඩු වෙන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. හැබැයි ඔයා මේ නිරාහාරව ඉන්න 12ව වෙනි පැයෙන් පස්සේ මේ වරදක හෝමෝනය ආයෙත් වැඩි වෙන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. මේ වර්ධක හෝමෝයේ වැඩිවීම ඔයාගේ මේද දහනයට මාංශරේෂී අලුත් වැඩියාවට සහ සෛල ප්‍රතිනිර්මාණයට ගොඩක් උදව් වෙනවා. මෙන්න මේක තමයි මේ ඉන්ටරමිටන් පාස්තින් කියන ක්‍රමවේදය. [සංගීතය] ොටෝපැජි කියන එකේ තේරුම තමයි සොයං අනුභවය කියන එක. ඒ කියන්නේ අපේ ශරීරය විසින් අපේ ශරීරයේම තියෙන කොටස් ශක්තිය ලබා ගැනීම සඳහා බිඳ දමන එක. මේකෙන් ශරීරයට වාසි ගොඩක් අත් වෙනවා. ඔයාගේ ශරීරයේ තියෙන ඩැමේජ් වුණු ප්‍රෝටීන් අයින් වෙනවා. ඩැමේජ් යුණු වුණු ඒ වගේම පරණ වුණු සෛල නැවත ප්‍රතිනිර්මාණය කරනවා. ඔයාගේ ආයු කාලය වැඩි වෙනවා. ඒ වගේම මොලේ සෛල වල ක්‍රියාකාරීත්වය වැඩි දියුණු වෙනවා. මේ ඔටෝපැජ්ජි කියන එක ඔයාගේ අවසාන කෑම වේවේල ඉඳලා නිරාහාරව ඉන්න 12වෙනි පැයෙන් පස්සේ තමයි අවදි වෙන්නේ. එතන ඉඳලා ඔයා නිරාහාරව ඉන්න කාලය වැඩි වෙනකොට මේ ඔටෝපජ නිසා ඔයාට ලැබෙන ප්‍රතිලාභ තව තව වැඩි වෙනවා. මේක තමයි ඔයාගේ සෛලීය මට්ටමේ තියෙන අභ්‍යන්තර ක්ලීනින් සිස්ටම් එක. මෙයාව ඇහැරෝ ගන් එක එච්චර ලේසි වැඩක් නෙමෙයි. මේක කරන්න පුළුවන් මේඉනටමටන් ෆාස්ටින කියන ක්‍රමවේදය හරහා. [සංගීතය] මේ නිරාහාරව ඉන්න ක්‍රමවේදය ඇතුලෙදී ඔයාගේ හෝමෝන වල ක්‍රියාකාරීත්වය වැඩි දියුණු වෙනවා. ඉන්සුලින් අඩු වෙනවා. ඉන්සුලින් අඩු වෙනකොට මේද දහනය පහසු වෙනවා. වර්ධක හෝමෝනය පස් ගුණයකින් වැඩි වෙනවා. එතකොට මේද දහනය වෙනවා වගේම වංශ පේෂී අලුත් වැඩියා වීම සිද්ධ වෙනවා. ඔයාගේ නොරෙප්‍රීන් ප්‍රයින් මට්ටම ඉහළ යනවා. මේක තමයි හෝමෝනය ඔයාව හැමවෙලේම ඇලට් එකේ තියාගන්න. එතකොට ඔයාගේ පරිවෘත්තීය ක්‍රියාවලිය වේගවත් වෙනවා. ග්‍රලින් සහ ලෙප්ටින් කියන හෝමෝන සමතුලිත වෙනවා. මේකෙන් කාලයත් එක්ක ඔයාට හැකියාව ලැබෙනවා ඔයාගේ බඩ ගින්න සහ බඩ පිරීම පාලනය කරන්න. මෙන්න මේ හෝමෝන සමතුලිත වීම ඉන්ටරමිටන් පාස්ටිනන් එකෙන් ඔයාට ලැබෙන සල්ලි දීලවත් ගන්න බැරි තරමේ විශාල ප්‍රතිලාභයක්. ඔයා මේඉටරමිටන් පාස්ටි කියන ක්‍රමවේදය නිරන්තරයෙන් අනුගමනය කරනවා නම් මේකෙන් ඔයාට දිගුකාලන ප්‍රතිලාභ රාශියක් ලැබෙනවා. මීට අමතරව මේඉටරමිටන් ෆාස්ටින ක්‍රමවේදය හරහා ඔයාට ලැබෙන විද්‍යාත්මකව තහවුරු කරපු ප්‍රතිලාභ රාශියක් තියෙනවා. පළවෙනි එක තමයි ඔයාගේ බර අඩු වීම. ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම පහළ වැඩනකොට ඔයාගේ මේද දහනය වීම සිද්ධ වෙනවා. එතකොට ඔයාගේ කැලරි පාලනය වීම වැඩි දියුණු වෙනවා. මේකෙන් ඔයාගේ බර අඩු වෙනවා. දෙවනි එක තමයි ඔයාගේ පරිවෘත්තීය ක්‍රියාවලිය වැඩි දියුණු වීම. මෙතනදී ඔයාගේ ඉන්සුලින් සංවේදිතාවය වැඩි වෙනවා. එතකොට ඔයාට ටයිප් ආකාරය දිය වැඩියා තත්ත්වය ඇතිවීමේ අවධානම ගොඩක් අඩු වෙනවා. තුන්වෙනි එක තමයි මොලයේ ක්‍රියාකාරීත්වය තියුණු වීම. කීටෝන ඔයාගේ මොලයට අනවරතව ශක්තිය ලබා දෙන නිසා මොලයේ ක්‍රියාකාරීත්වය වැඩි දියුණු වෙනවා. හතරවෙනි එක තමයි අභ්‍යන්තර වේදනාවන් අඩුවීම. මෙතනදි ඔයාගේ ප්‍රතිශක්තිකරණ පද්ධතිය අලුත් වැඩියා වෙන නිසා ඔයාගේ තියෙන අභ්‍යන්තර වේදනාවන් ගොඩක් අඩු වෙනවා. පස්වෙනි එක තමයි ඔයාගේ ආයු කාලය වැඩිවෙන එක. අත්දින වලින් හොයාගෙන තියෙනවා මේ ෆාස්ටින් ක්‍රමවේදය නිරන්තරයෙන් අනුගමනය කරනකොට ඒක ඔයාගේ ආයු කාලය වැඩි වෙන්නත් හේතු වෙනවා කියලා. ඇත්තටම මේ ඉන්ටරමිටන් ෆාස්ටින කියන්නේ විද්‍යාත්මකව තහවුරු කරපු බොහොම බලගතු පරිවෘතීය ක්‍රමවේදයක්. [සංගීතය] දැන් ඔයාට හිතනවා ඇති මේ පැය 16ක් නිරාහාරව ඉන්නකොට පැය අටක් කෑම ගන්නකොට මේ පැය අටයේ කාල පාරාසය ඇතුලේදී මොනවද කන්න හොඳ? කොච්චර ප්‍රමාණයක් කන්න හොඳද කොහොමද මේ කෑම ගන්නේ වගේ ප්‍රශ්න ටිකක්. පැය 16ක් නිරාහාරව හිටියට මේ කෑම ගන්න පැය අටේදී රටේ නැති ඔක්කොම ජරාව ටික කන්න බැහැ. මේ කෑම කන කාල පරාසය ඇතුලෙදීත් අපි ආහාරයට ගත යුත්තේ හිත කර ආහාර විතරයි. ඒ කියන්නේ මෙන්න මේ දේවල්. අංක එක ලීන් ප්‍රෝටීන් විත්තර චිකන්, මේද සහිත මාළු, ග්‍රීක් යෝගට් ආහාරමේය තන්තු බහුලව අඩංගු වෙන ආහාර එළවලු, පළතුරු සහ සම්පූර්ණ ධාන්‍ය. ඊළඟට හිත කර මේ දේ. ඇට වර්ග, බීජ වර්ග, ඔලිව් o ඔයිල්, අලිගෙඩ පේර වගේ දේවල්. ඊළඟට සංකීර්ණ කාබෝහයිට්‍රට අඩංගු ආහාර ඕට්ස්, කීනෝවා, රතුබත්, පරිප කඩල, කව්පි, මුන් ඇට, රටකු, බෝංචි වර්ග රල කුලයේ ආහාර ඒ වගේම කන්න හොඳ නැති දේවල් එහෙකුත් තියෙනවා. ඒ තමයි සේනිදාපු බිම වර්ග, බේකරි කෑම පේස්ටී වගේ දේවල්, රස කැවිලි වගේ දේවල්, කෘතිමව සීනි එකතු කරලා හදපු පැනි රසකාර කාරක, ගැඹුරු තෙලේ බැපු ආහාර, අධික පිටි සහිත ආහාර වගේම සැකසූ ආහාර. මෙන්න මේ පැය කාලේදී මේ වගේ කෑම කෑවොත් නම් ඔයාගේ ඉන්සුලින් මට්ටම ගොඩක් වැඩිවෙලා ඔයාට අර පැය 16 කාලය ඇතුල් ගන්න පුළුවන් ප්‍රතිලාභ ටික ගොඩක් අඩු වෙනවා. transcript: Imagine living off sunlight, feeding on decaying matter or sharing nutrients with another organism in a win-win partnership. Fascinating, right? This video explores the types of nutrition where every organism has its own unique dining style. Nutrition is the way in which an organism acquires nutrients. There are three major types of nutrition which are autotrophic nutrition, heterrophic nutrition, and symbiotic nutrition. Let's start with autotrophic nutrition. Autorophic nutrition is a type of nutrition in which organisms produce their own food from simple organic materials such as carbon dioxide, water, and mineral salts. This type of nutrition is seen in green plants and some bacteria. Green plants take in carbon dioxide and water and using sunlight they produce their own food glucose by the process called photosynthesis. Did you know the largest autoro on earth is a massive aspen grove called po in Utah weighing over 6,000 tons. The second type of nutrition is heterotrophic nutrition. Heterotrophic nutrition is a mode of nutrition in which organisms depend on other organisms for food. Heterotrophic organisms take in already made organic food such as vegetables, fruits, and meat. This type of nutrition is exhibited by most animals. Most animals take other organisms either plants or other animals as food. Heterotrophic nutrition is divided into three types. സോഡിയം പൊട്ടാസ്യം പിന്നെ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് അതുപോലെതന്നെ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ അളവ് നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക എന്നിവയെല്ലാം വളരെ അത്യാവശ്യമായിട്ട് ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട ഒരു കാര്യമാണ് എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് ഈ പോഷകങ്ങൾ [സംഗീതം] വൃക്കരോഗികളിൽ നിയന്ത്രിക്കണം എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് നമ്മുടെ ശരീരത്തിൽ എല്ലാ പോഷകങ്ങളും ആവശ്യമാണ് അത് ശരീരത്തിൽ അധികമായി വരുമ്പോൾ നമുക്ക് യൂറിനിലൂടെ അത് പുറന്തള്ളപ്പെടുകയാണ് സാധാരണയായി നടക്കുന്നത് എന്നാൽ വൃക്കരോഗികളിൽ അവരുടെ വൃക്കക്ക് തകരാറുകൾ ഉള്ള സമയത്ത് നമുക്ക് [സംഗീതം] അധികമായി വരുന്ന പോഷകങ്ങളെ പുറന്തള്ളപ്പെടുകയില്ല അത് ശരീരത്തിൽ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വൃക്കയിൽ തന്നെ അടിഞ്ഞു കൂടുകയാണ് സ്വാഭാവികമായും നടക്കുന്നത് അപ്പോ നമുക്ക് എന്തും അധികമായാൽ അമൃതം വിഷമാണല്ലോ അപ്പോ പുറത്തു പോകേണ്ട പോഷകങ്ങൾ എല്ലാം ശരീരത്തിൽ അടിഞ്ഞു കൂടുന്നത് മൂലം എല്ലാ രീതിയിലും നമുക്ക് നമുക്ക് ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുകൾ ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു അതില പ്രോട്ടീൻ പ്രോട്ടീൻ നമുക്ക് ആവശ്യമുള്ള ശരീരത്തിൽ ആവശ്യമുള്ള പ്രക്രിയകള എല്ലാം നടന്നതിനുശേഷം അതിന്റെ എൻഡ് പ്രോഡക്റ്റ് ആയ യൂറിയയും ക്രിയാറ്റിനും ആയിട്ട് അത് ഒരു വിഷമാലിന്യമാണ് അത് നമ്മുടെ ശരീരത്തിൽ അടിഞ്ഞു കൂടി കഴിഞ്ഞു കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ നല്ല രീതിയിലുള്ള ഒരു ബുദ്ധിമുട്ട് നമുക്ക് ഉണ്ടാകും അപ്പോ [സംഗീതം] യൂറിയയും ക്രിയാറ്റിനിനും പുറന്തള്ളപ്പെടുത്തപ്പെടാത്തിടത്തോളം നമ്മൾ പ്രോട്ടീൻറെ ഇൻറേക്ക് കുറച്ചുകൂടെഒന്ന് ലിമിറ്റ് ചെയ്യേണ്ടത് ആവശ്യമാണ് അതുപോലെ തന്നെയാണ് പൊട്ടാസ്യവും പൊട്ടാസ്യം ഒരു രീതിയിൽ നമുക്ക് നല്ലതാണ്. പക്ഷേ ഈ പറയുന്ന പോലെ തന്നെ നിയന്ത്രണാതീതമായി വരികയാണെങ്കിൽ അത് നമ്മുടെ ഹൃദയത്താളം അതായത് ഹാർട്ട് ബീറ്റിനെ ബാധിക്കുകയും അത് കൺട്രോൾ ഇല്ലാതെ വന്നു കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ [സംഗീതം] നമ്മുടെ ഹാർട്ടിനെ തന്നെ അത് ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നുണ്ട്. അപ്പോ അതുകൊണ്ട് പൊട്ടാസ്യം അടങ്ങിയ ഭക്ഷണങ്ങൾ ഹൃദയ വൃക്കരോഗികൾ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ തന്നെ ലിമിറ്റ് ചെയ്യേണ്ടത് ആവശ്യമാണ്. പിന്നീട് വരുന്നത് സോഡിയം ആണ്. സോഡിയം എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞു കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ ഉപ്പ് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ബാക്കിയുള്ള പച്ചക്കറികളിൽ നിന്നൊക്കെ നമുക്ക് സോഡിയം കിട്ടുന്നുണ്ട്. അതും അധികമായി കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ [സംഗീതം] നമ്മുടെ ഒരു ശരീരത്തിൽ ഒരു ജലസന്തുലിതാവസ്ഥയുണ്ട്. ആ ഒരു അവസ്ഥയനെ താളം തെറ്റിക്കുകയും കൂടാതെ ശരീരത്തിൽ വെള്ളം അടിഞ്ഞുകൂടി നീർക്കെട്ടുകൾ ഉണ്ടാവുകയും അതുപോലെ സോഡിയം കൂടികഴിഞ്ഞാൽ അത് ബിപി ഹൈപ്പർടെൻഷൻ ഉയർത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നുണ്ട്. [സംഗീതം] പിന്നെ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് നമുക്ക് ശരീരത്തിന് ആവശ്യമായിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു പോഷകം തന്നെയാണ് എന്നിരുന്നാലും അത് അധികമായി കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ ശരീരത്തിലുള്ള കാൽസ്യം ഫോസ്ഫറസ് റേഷ്യോ അത് ബാധിക്കുകയും കാൽസ്യത്തിന്റെ അളവ് കുറയുന്നത് മൂലം നമുക്ക് എല്ലുകളുടെയും പല്ലുകളുടെയും ഒക്കെ ബലം ക്ഷയിക്കുകയും ചർമ്മത്തിൽ ഒരുപാട് ചൊറിച്ചിൽ പോലുള്ള ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുകൾ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ കുറച്ചുകൂടെ അത് വഷളാവുകയാണെന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഹൃദയത്തിന് തന്നെ അത് ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുണ്ടാക്കുന്നതാണ് ഈ പൊട്ടാസ്യം കൂടുതൽ അടങ്ങിയിട്ടുള്ള ഭക്ഷണങ്ങൾ ഏതൊക്കെയാണ് പറയ പൊട്ടാസ്യത്തിന്റെ നാച്ചുറൽ സോഴ്സുകളാണ് പച്ചക്കറികളും അതുപോലെ പഴവർഗ്ഗങ്ങളും അപ്പോ കൂടുതലായിട്ട് അടങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നത് എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞു കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ നമ്മുടെ വാഴപ്പഴം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ [സംഗീതം] സിട്രസ് ആയിട്ടുള്ള ഫ്രൂട്സ് ഓറഞ്ച് മുസമ്പി നാരങ്ങ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള ഫ്രൂട്സുകളിൽ എല്ലാം പൊട്ടാസ്യം നല്ല രീതിയിൽ അടങ്ങിയിട്ടുണ്ട് അതുപോലെ ഉരുളക്കിഴങ്ങ് മറ്റു കിഴങ്ങ് വർഗ്ഗങ്ങൾ എല്ലാം തന്നെ അതുപോലെ [സംഗീതം] ചീര മുരിങ്ങ റാഗി പിന്നെ മറ്റു പലവിധ ഫ്രൂട്ട്സുകളും നല്ല രീതിയിൽ പൊട്ടാസ്യം കൂടുതലുള്ള ഭക്ഷണങ്ങളാണ് അപ്പോ ഇതെല്ലാം നിയന്ത്രിക്കേണ്ടവയാണ് അതെ ഈ പറഞ്ഞ പൊട്ടാസ്യം കൂടുതലുള്ള ഭക്ഷണങ്ങളെല്ലാം നമ്മൾ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ നിയന്ത്രിക്കേണ്ടവയാണ് അപ്പ ഏതൊക്കെ പഴങ്ങളാണ് വൃക്കരോഗികൾക്ക് കഴിക്കാൻ [സംഗീതം] പറ്റുന്നത് നമുക്ക് വളരെ ലിമിറ്റഡ് ആയിട്ടുള്ള കുറച്ച് ഫ്രൂട്സ് മാത്രമേ നമുക്ക് വൃക്കരോഗികൾക്ക് [സംഗീതം] കഴിക്കാനായിട്ട് പറ്റുന്നുള്ളൂ അതിൽ പ്രധാനമായിട്ടും വരുന്നത് ആപ്പിൾ [സംഗീതം] പേരക്ക അധികം പഴുക്കാത്തതും തീരെ പച്ച അല്ലാത്തതുമായ പപ്പായ കഴിക്കാം പിന്നെ ഡയബറ്റിക് അല്ലാത്ത പേഷ്യൻസിന് ചെറിയ [സംഗീതം] അളവിൽ പൈനാപ്പിൾ നമുക്ക് കഴിക്കാവുന്നതാണ് ഫോസ്ഫറസ് കൂടുതലുള്ള ഭക്ഷണങ്ങൾ ഏതൊക്കെയാണ് [സംഗീതം] ഫോസ്ഫറസ് അധികമായിട്ടുള്ളത് നമ്മുടെ പാല് പാലഉൽപന്നങ്ങൾ അതായത് തൈര് മോര് യോഗർട്ട് [സംഗീതം] ചീസ് പനീർ അതുപോലെയുള്ള പാലും പാലിന്റെതായ ഉൽപന്നങ്ങളിലും എല്ലാം നല്ല രീതിയിൽ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് കൂടുതലാണ് അതുപോലെ മുട്ടയുടെ മഞ്ഞക്കരു കടല പരിപ്പ് പിന്നെ നമ്മുടെ ബേക്കറി ഐറ്റംസ് ഇവയിലെല്ലാം നല്ല രീതിയിൽ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് കൂടുതലാണ് അപ്പോ [സംഗീതം] ഇതെല്ലാം നിയന്ത്രിക്കേണ്ടവയാണ് ഇവയെല്ലാം ഒരു പരിധി വരെ നമുക്ക് ഉപയോഗിക്കാം ഈ പറഞ്ഞ ഫോസ്ഫറസിന്റെ ലെവൽ ഉയരുകയാണെങ്കിൽ നമ്മൾ ഇതെല്ലാം ഒരു കൺട്രോളിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരേണ്ടത് അത്യാവശ്യമാണ് ഈ വൃക്കരോഗികൾക്ക് വെള്ളം കുടിക്കുന്നതിന് നിയന്ത്രണം ഉണ്ടല്ലോ അതിനെകുറിച് ഒന്ന് പറയാമോ [സംഗീതം] വൃക്കരോഗികൾ വെള്ളം കുടിക്കേണ്ടത് രണ്ടു രീതിയിലാണ് അതായത് ഡയാലിസിസ് ഉള്ളവർക്ക് ഒരു രീതി ഡയാലിസിസ് ഇല്ലാത്തവർക്ക് മറ്റൊരു രീതി കാരണം ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യാത്തവർക്ക് ഒരു ഒരു ലിറ്റർ മുതൽ ഒന്നര ലിറ്റർ വരെ വെള്ളത്തിലേക്ക് നമുക്ക് പോകാൻ പറ്റും അത് നമുക്ക് ഡോക്ടേഴ്സ് അവരുടെ മൂത്രത്തിന്റെ അളവ് [സംഗീതം] അനുസരിച്ച് ഡോക്ടർസ് കൃത്യമായി പറയും എത്ര അളവിൽ വരെ നമുക്ക് പോകാം എന്നുള്ളത് എന്നാൽ ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിന ആണെങ്കിൽ ഒരു 600 മുതൽ 800 ml വെള്ളം വരെ നമുക്ക് കുടിക്കാനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കുകയുള്ളൂ. കാരണം അവരുടെ ശരീരത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ഈ മൂത്രം പോകുന്നതിന്റെ അളവ് വളരെ കുറവായതുകൊണ്ട്തന്നെ അവർ കുടിക്കുന്ന വെള്ളം ശരീരത്തിൽ തന്നെ തങ്ങി നിൽക്കുകയാണ് [സംഗീതം] ചെയ്യുന്നത് അങ്ങനെ തങ്ങി നിൽക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ട് ശരീരത്തിലെ നീർക്കെട്ട് ഉയരുകയും അത് അവർക്ക് ശാരീരികമായ കുറച്ച് ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുകളിലേക്ക് പോവുകയും ചെയ്യാറുണ്ട് ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിനും ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യാത്ത പേഷ്യൻസിനും വെള്ളം കുടിക്കേണ്ട രീതികളെ കുറിച്ച് പറഞ്ഞല്ലോ [സംഗീതം] അപ്പോ അതുപോലെ പ്രോട്ടീനിന്റെ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള അളവുകളിലും ഈ ഡയാലിസിസ് [സംഗീതം] ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിനും അല്ലാത്തവർ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ടോ തീർച്ചയായും ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യാത്ത പേഷ്യൻസ് ആണെങ്കിൽ നമ്മൾ ഈ പറഞ്ഞ സോഡിയം പൊട്ടാസ്യം പ്രോട്ടീൻ എന്നിവയുടെ ഒക്കെ അളവിൽ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ നിയന്ത്രണം വരുത്തണം എന്നാൽ [സംഗീതം] ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിന ആണെങ്കിൽ സോഡിയവും പൊട്ടാസ്യവും എല്ലാം നമ്മൾ കൺട്രോളിൽ തന്നെ കൊണ്ടുവരണം എന്നാൽ പ്രോട്ടീൻ അടങ്ങിയ ഭക്ഷണം നന്നായിട്ട് നമ്മൾ കഴിക്കുകയാണ് [സംഗീതം] ചെയ്യേണ്ടത് കാരണം നമ്മൾ ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ നമുക്ക് ആവശ്യമായ പോഷകങ്ങളിൽ പ്രോട്ടീൻറെ അളവ് നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടുപോകും ശരീരത്തിന്റെ സ്വാഭാവിക ഘടന നിലനിർത്താനായിട്ട് ആവശ്യമുള്ള ഒരു പ്രോട്ടീനും കൂടിയാണ് പക്ഷേ അത് നമുക്ക് ഡയാലിസിസിലൂടെ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടു പോകുമ്പോൾ പേഷ്യൻസിന് നല്ല രീതിയിൽ ക്ഷീണവും ഉണ്ടാകും അതുപോലെ അവർക്ക് അവരുടെ ശരീരം പ്രവർത്തിക്കാൻ ആവശ്യമായ പ്രോട്ടീൻ നമുക്ക് നിലനിർത്താനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കാതെയും വരുന്നുണ്ട് അപ്പോ അതുകൊണ്ടാണ് നമ്മൾ ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിന് [സംഗീതം] നല്ല രീതിയിൽ പ്രോട്ടീൻ കഴിക്കുക എന്ന് നമ്മൾ പറയുന്നത് വൃക്കരോഗികൾക്കുള്ള മികച്ച [സംഗീതം] ഭക്ഷണശീലങ്ങൾ എന്തൊക്കെയാണ് വൃക്കരോഗികൾ പ്രധാനമായിട്ടും ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ടത് പ്രോട്ടീൻ [സംഗീതം] സോഡിയം പൊട്ടാസ്യം അതുപോലെ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് ഈ പോഷകങ്ങൾ അടങ്ങിയ ഭക്ഷണങ്ങളുടെ ഉപയോഗം ഒന്ന് നിയ നിയന്ത്രണത്തിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരിക അതുപോലെ വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഉപയോഗമാണെങ്കിലും അമിതമാകാതെ ഒരു ഡോക്ടർ പറയുന്ന ഒരു അളവിൽ തന്നെ നിർത്താനായിട്ട് നോക്കുക അതായത് വെള്ളം എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞു കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ എല്ലാവരും കുടിവെള്ളം മാത്രമാണ് ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നത് പക്ഷേ [സംഗീതം] അങ്ങനെയല്ല നമ്മൾ കുടിക്കുന്ന ചായയോ കാപ്പിയോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മരുന്ന് കുടിക്കുന്ന വെള്ളമായിട്ടോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ലിക്വിഡ് ഫോമിൽ എടുക്കുന്ന എല്ലാം തന്നെ ഈവൻ നമ്മൾ കറികളിൽ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്ന വെള്ളം വരെ ഡോക്ടർ പറയുന്ന അതായത് ഇപ്പോ ഒരു ലിറ്റർആ പറയുന്നതെങ്കിൽ അതിൽ തന്നെ നമ്മൾ ചുരുക്കേണ്ടത് അത്യാവശ്യമാണ് പിന്നെ പ്രധാനമായിട്ടും ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ടത് നമ്മൾ കഴിക്കുന്ന ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്റെ അളവൊന്ന് നിയന്ത്രിച്ച് ഇടവേളകളിൽ ആക്കി കഴിക്കുകയാണെന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അത് അവർക്ക് ഒരു ബുദ്ധിമുട്ട് ഉണ്ടാവാതെ ഇരിക്കും നമുക്ക് മൊത്തത്തിൽ അവരുടെ ഒരു ഹെൽത്തിനെ കുറച്ചുകൂടെ ഒന്ന് ക്ഷീണം മാറ്റിയെടുക്കാനായിട്ട് നല്ലതായിരിക്കും ഇപ്പോ ഡയാലിസിസ് പേഷ്യൻസിന് ഇതിൽ നിന്ന് വിപരീതമായിട്ട് എന്തെങ്കിലും ചെയ്യാനുണ്ടോ തീർച്ചയായും ഞാൻ നേരത്തെ തന്നെ പറഞ്ഞു ഡയാലിസിസ് പേഷ്യൻസിന് പ്രോട്ടീൻറെ അളവ് കുറച്ചുകൂടെ അധികമായിട്ട് നമുക്ക് വേണം അതുപോലെതന്നെ പ്രോട്ടീൻ അടങ്ങിയ ഭക്ഷണങ്ങൾ അധികമായി [സംഗീതം] കഴിക്കുക അതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നെ ഡയാലിസിസ് ഉള്ള പേഷ്യൻസി ഏറ്റവും നല്ല ഒരു പ്രോട്ടീൻ സോഴ്സ് ആണ് മുട്ടയുടെ വെള്ള എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് കാരണം ബാക്കിയുള്ള നോൺവെജ് നമ്മൾ നോക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ അതിനകത്തൊക്കെ ഫോസ്ഫറസിന്റെ അളവ് നല്ല രീതിയിൽ കൂടുതലാണ് ഇപ്പോ മുട്ടയുടെ വെള്ളം എടുക്കുകയാണെന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിൽ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ പ്രോട്ടീൻ കണ്ടെന്റ് ഉണ്ട് ഫോസ്ഫറസിന്റെ അളവ് കുറവുമാണ് [സംഗീതം] ഒരു ദിവസം രണ്ടോ മൂന്നോ മുട്ടയുടെ വെള്ളയായിട്ടൊക്കെ നമുക്ക് ഉപയോഗിക്കാൻ സാധിക്കുകയാണെന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ കുറച്ചുകൂടെ നല്ലതായിരിക്കും [സംഗീതം] കാരണം ഏറ്റവും ബയോ അവൈലബിലിറ്റി കൂടിയ പ്രോട്ടീൻ സോസ് എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് മുട്ടയാണ് [സംഗീതം] അപ്പോ ഡെയിലി മൂന്ന് മുട്ടയുടെ വെള്ളയായിട്ട് തന്നെ എടുക്കാം പ്രോട്ടീന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ മാത്രമാണ് നമുക്ക് കുറച്ചുകൂടെ ഒരു ചേഞ്ച് ഡയാലിസിസ് [സംഗീതം] പേഷ്യൻസിന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ വരുന്നത് അല്ലാതെ തന്നെ സോഡിയം പൊട്ടാസ്യം ഫോസ്ഫറസ് അതെല്ലാം നമ്മൾ സാധാരണ രീതിയിൽ തന്നെ നമ്മൾ നിയന്ത്രിക്കേണ്ടത് അത്യാവശ്യമാണ് പിന്നെ ഒരു കാര്യം എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് നമ്മൾ ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന പേഷ്യൻസിന് വെള്ളം കുടിക്കുന്നതിന്റെ അളവ് വീണ്ടും കുറവായിരിക്കും [സംഗീതം] ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യാത്ത പേഷ്യൻസിനെ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു നോക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ ഒരു 600 മുതൽ 800 മില്ലി വരെ ആയിരിക്കും നമുക്ക് കുടിക്കാൻ പറ്റുന്ന വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ അളവ് [സംഗീതം] എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് അപ്പോ ഇതൊക്കെയാണ് നമ്മൾ വൃക്കരോഗികളിൽ തന്നെ ഡയാലിസിസ്ച ഇത് ചെയ്യുന്നവരും ചെയ്യാത്തവരും തമ്മിലുള്ള ഒരു ഭക്ഷണ രീതിയിലുള്ള വ്യത്യാസം എന്ന് പറയുന്നത്. വൃക്കരോഗികളിൽ അതിൽ തന്നെ ഡയാലിസിസ് ചെയ്യുന്നവരിൽ എച്ച്ബി കൗണ്ട് കുറയുന്നതായിട്ട് ഇങ്ങനെ കാണാറുണ്ടല്ലോ. അപ്പോൊ അവർക്ക് അത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് അങ്ങനെ വരുന്നത്? അത് ഓവർകം [സംഗീതം] ചെയ്യാനുള്ള വഴികൾ എന്തൊക്കെയാണ് എന്ന് പ്രേക്ഷകരോട് പറയാം. നമുക്ക് വൃക്കരോഗികളിൽ എച്ച്ബി കൗണ്ട് കുറയുക എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് നമുക്കത് ഡയറ്റ് വഴി നമുക്ക് ഒന്നും ചെയ്യാനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കില്ല. കാരണം [സംഗീതം] എച്ച്ബി കൗണ്ട് കൂടാനായിട്ട് നമ്മൾ കഴിക്കുന്ന ഭക്ഷണം നമ്മൾ വൃക്കരോഗികൾ കഴിക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ അവരിൽ പൊട്ടാസ്യത്തിന്റെ അളവ് നല്ല രീതിയിൽ കൂടും. അപ്പൊ അതുകൊണ്ട് നമുക്ക് ഭക്ഷണം വഴി നമുക്ക് എച്ച്ബി ഒന്ന് കറക്റ്റ് ചെയ്യുക എന്ന് പറയുന്നത് കുറച്ച് ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുള്ള കാര്യമാണ്. പക്ഷേ [സംഗീതം] എച്ച്ബി കൗണ്ട് കുറയുന്നത് ഭക്ഷണത്തിന്റെ അഭാവം മൂലമുള്ള ഒരു പ്രശ്നമല്ല. കാരണം കിഡ്നി പ്രൊഡ്യൂസ് ചെയ്യുന്ന എർത്രോപോയിട്ടിൻ എന്നൊരു ഹോർമോൺ ആണ് നമുക്ക് ആർബിസി പ്രൊഡ്യൂസ് ചെയ്യാനായിട്ട് [സംഗീതം] ഹെൽപ്പ് ചെയ്യുന്നത്. എന്നാൽ ഈ കിഡ്നിക്ക് എന്തെങ്കിലും തകരാർ സംഭവിക്കുമ്പോൾ ആ ഹോർമോണിന്റെ പ്രൊഡക്ഷൻ കുറയുകയും [സംഗീതം] എർത്തോപോയിട്ടിന്റെ അളവ് നമുക്ക് കുറയുകയും അതുവഴി ആർബിസിയുടെ പ്രൊഡക്ഷൻ കുറയുന്നത് മൂലം എച്ച് ബി കൗണ്ടും തീർച്ചയായും കുറഞ്ഞു പോകുന്നു അപ്പോ അത് നമുക്ക് ഒന്നും ഡയറ്റ് വഴിയിട്ടൊന്നും കറക്റ്റ് ചെയ്യാനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കുന്നതല്ല അത് കിഡ്നിക്ക് ഒരു ഡാമേജ് ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ട് അത് സ്വാഭാവികമായി അങ്ങ് നടന്നു പോകുന്നതാണ് ഡയാലിസിസിന്റെ സമയത്ത് ഇൻചക്ഷനോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മെഡിസിൻ ത്രൂ നമുക്ക്ത് കറക്ട് ചെയ്യാനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കുകയുള്ളൂ നമ്മുടെ ഹോസ്പിറ്റലിൽ തന്നെയാണ് ങ്കിൽ വൃക്കരോഗികളുടെ [സംഗീതം] എണ്ണം ദിനംപ്രതി കൂടികൂടി വരികയാണ് വൃക്കരോഗം വരാതിരിക്കാനായിട്ട് എന്തെങ്കിലും വഴികളുണ്ടോ നമുക്കൊരു [സംഗീതം] പരിധി വരെ നമുക്ിത് കൺട്രോൾ ചെയ്യാൻ പറ്റും പ്രധാനമായി നമ്മൾ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ടത് നമുക്ക് ചെറുപ്രായത്തിൽ തന്നെ പ്രഷറിന്റെ എന്തെങ്കിലും ബുദ്ധിമുട്ട് കാണിക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ ബിപിയിൽ എന്തെങ്കിലും വേരിയേഷൻസ് കാണിക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ നമ്മൾഒരു കറക്റ്റ് ആയിരു ചെക്പ്പ് ചെയ്യുക അതുപോലെ നമുക്ക് ഷുഗർ തുടങ്ങുമ്പോൾ തന്നെ അതിനെ ഡയറ്റ് ചെയ്തോ അല്ലെങ്കി എക്സസൈസ് ചെയ്തോ ഡോക്ടർസിനെ കാണിച്ച് മെഡിസിൻ [സംഗീതം] ഒക്കെ വാങ്ങിച്ച് ഷുഗർ ഒന്ന് കൺട്രോളിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരുക കാരണം ഷുഗർ നമുക്ക് ന അൺകൺട്രോൾഡ് ആയിട്ട് വരുകയാണെങ്കിൽ നമ്മുടെ മറ്റ് ഓർഗൻസിനെ ഇപ് കിഡ്നി ഡയബറ്റിക് നെഫ്രോപതി പോലെ നുക്ക് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ കണ്ണിനെ ബാധിക്കുന്ന റെനോപതി പോലെഒക്കെ നമുക്ക് ആവാം അത് ത്രൂ നമുക്ക് ഡയാലിസിസിലേക്ൊക്കെ നമുക്ക് എത്തിപ്പെടേണ്ട ഒരു അവസ്ഥ ഉണ്ടാകുന്നുണ്ട് അപ്പോ അതുകൊണ്ട് ഷുഗർ പ്രഷർ തുടങ്ങിയ അസുഖങ്ങൾ നമുക്ക് ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ എല്ലാം [സംഗീതം] ഒന്ന് കൺട്രോളിൽ കൊണ്ടുവരിക അനാരോഗ്യകരമായ ഒരു ഭക്ഷണരീതി അത് എല്ലാ ഒരു പ്രശ്നത്തിന്റെയും അടിസ്ഥാനപരമായ ഒരു കാര്യമാണ് അതുകൊണ്ടുതന്നെ [സംഗീതം] ഭക്ഷണരീതി ചെറുപ്രായത്തിൽ തന്നെ നമ്മൾ നല്ല രീതിയിലുള്ള ഒരു ഭക്ഷണരീതി നമ്മൾ ഫോളോ ചെയ്യാനയിട്ട് നോക്കുക പക്ഷേ [സംഗീതം] ഇഷ്ടമുള്ള ഭക്ഷണം നമുക്ക് കഴിക്കാം എന്നുമെന്നും കഴിക്കാതിരിക്കാൻ നോക്കുക അളവ് നിയന്ത്രിച്ചു കഴിക്കുക ആ ഒരു രീതിയിൽ നമ്മൾ പോവുകയാണെങ്കിൽ അത്യാവശ്യം എല്ലാ അസുഖങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നും നമുക്കൊരു കൺട്രോൾ നമുക്ക് ഉണ്ടാവുന്നതാണ് അതായത് ഒരു ആരോഗ്യകരമായ ജീവിതരീതി നമ്മൾ മുമപോട്ട് നയിക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ [സംഗീതം] കിഡ്നി റിലേറ്റഡ് ആയിട്ടുള്ള അസുഖങ്ങളോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നമുക്ക് ലൈഫ് സ്റ്റൈൽ ഡിസീസോ എല്ലാത്തിനെയും തന്നെ നമുക്ക് ക്യൂർ ചെയ്യാനായിട്ട് സാധിക്കുന്നതാണ് വളരെയധികം ഇൻഫർമേറ്റീവ് [സംഗീതം] ആയിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു സെഷൻ ആയിരുന്നു ഇന്ന് ജോസ്നയോടൊപ്പം നമുക്ക് ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നത് മറ്റൊരു [സംഗീതം] എപ്പിസോഡിൽ വേറൊരു ടോപ്പിക്കുമായി വീണ്ടും നമുക്ക് കാണാം ടിൽ ദെൻ ബൈ [സംഗീതം]

title: Breakfast Ranked - Nutrition Tier Lists
transcript: Hello everybody. This is Talon with another nutrition tier list. A series where I break down all the options in a given food group and rank them based on how nutritious they are and how good they are for your health. Today we don't have a food group per se, but definitely a food category. Breakfast foods. Often referred to as the most important meal of the day. It's definitely something you want to make sure you do correctly to start your day off right. The ideal breakfast is a meal that is nutritious to get your metabolism rolling, energizing to get you alert and ready to go and also satiating to keep you from feeling hungry until your next meal. These are traits you generally want in most meals, but I feel like they're especially important for breakfast. Now, I do need to address that breakfast is by definition the first meal of the day, which means it's pretty loose with what foods that entails. It's just whatever food breaks your fast. That could technically be buffalo wings and ice cream at 4:00 in the afternoon. Just to set proper expectations up front though, we're not covering Buffalo wings and ice cream. We're going to stick to the popular breakfast foods. So, looking at the tiers for this video, we're going to be comparing the nutrient content and benefits of each breakfast food against any shortcomings or health concerns that they may have. Keep in mind that these lists are ranked independent of each other. So, an A tier breakfast may not equate to an A tier fruit or an A tier vegetable. All numerical nutritional information on this list and across the series is based on 100 gram of the individual food for the sake of consistency and ease of comparison. And before we start, let me know what your typical breakfast looks like. Now, let's raise a toast to all of the excellent breakfast options and I guess the ones that donut have much to offer too and get to the list. First up is a more modern favorite. Avocado toast is a lowish calorie food with a solid micronutrient profile. For the numbers, I just did a 1:1 ratio of avocado to whole wheat toast by weight. Avocados are rich in oleic acid, a monounsaturated fatty acid that is good for heart health due to its anti-inflammatory, blood pressure, and LDL cholesterol-lowering effects. And when combined with the bread, it's a pretty fiber- dense duo, about 6 g of mainly insoluble fiber that promotes digestive regularity. And the combo is among the best sources on this list of manganesees, vitamin K, copper, vitamin B6, and vitamin E. Avocados are also naturally antioxidant-rich, including carotenonoids, pholic acids, and glutathione. Now, I should mention that this is a dish that commonly has other toppings added as well. Eggs, fish, cheese, fruits, veggies, and seasonings. But even plain old avocado toast achieves the breakfast goal of nutrients, energy, and satiety. And because of that, I'm going to put avocado toast in the A tier. Bacon is a very high calorie food with an inflated micronutrient profile to match. Though I doubt you'd be eating 100 grams of it. By weight, it's the highest in protein on this list, largely due to being a dehydrated meat. But it's also among the highest of protein per calorie, being a meat in a world of grains will do that. It is also the fattiest food on this list by a good margin, mainly consisting of monounsaturated fat, followed by saturated fat. Bacon is the highest on this list of selenium which is used as an antioxidant and to make DNA. Vitamin B3 niacin which helps convert food into energy, phosphorus, a structural component of bones, cell membranes, and DNA. And zinc, a mineral needed for immune function and wound healing. It's also among the best sources of many other B vitamins. Now, the protein, fat, and other nutrients do steer us toward our breakfast goals, but the processing, curing, and additives prevent it from coming even close to being considered a healthy choice. And so I'm going to put bacon in the C tier. A bagel is an average calorie food with a fine micronutrient profile. They're traditionally made more of hard wheat, the more protein dense kind of wheat. Thus, they actually have a surprisingly high protein content. They're also fairly fiber richch, about 4 g of mainly insoluble fiber. And they're typically among the better sources of manganese, selenium, and vitamin B1. Now, many store-bought bagels are more refined, meaning less protein and fiber and more simple carbs, which is not ideal for the likes of satiety and blood sugar and such. Though, finding whole grain bagels is doable without that much effort. And very rarely are bagels eaten alone. They're usually topped or filled with something, so their effectiveness depends on that. Meat, eggs, cheese, avocado, hummus, cream cheese, jelly. Realistically, this decision matters just as much as the bagel itself. All that to say, I'm going to put bagels in the C tier. Biscuits and gravy is an average calorie dish with a lesser micronutrient profile. There's quite a bit of variability among recipes, but I also think we're all generally on the same page when we think biscuits and gravy with some sausage mixed in there. It's not like it's a meal completely void of nutrients, notably phosphorus. But biscuits and gravy is largely defined by simple carbs and fat, low protein and fiber, generally empty calories that will not energize or satisfy you as much as many other common breakfast foods. Fair warning, there's going to be quite a few of these today and I'm likely just going to blaze right through them. But for now, let's put biscuits and gravy in the D tier. Cereal is typically a higher calorie food with a wild micronutrient profile. Obviously, there's a lot of different types and most of them get their nutrients from fortification. The best of them are fairly protein and fiber richch, though this is not a universal trait. And like I said, they're usually fortified with a ton of vitamins and minerals that I'm just going to list off. Vitamin B1, vitamin B2, vitamin B3, vitamin B6, folate, vitamin B12, calcium, copper, iron, magnesium, selenium, and zinc. That is to say, most of them, though many are naturally rich in manganesees and phosphorus on their own merit. But on the flip side, we've got to recognize that cereals themselves are mainly refined carbs loaded with added sugars resulting in a very high glycemic index, and they often contain artificial flavors and colors, which have been associated with gut issues and as a potential carcinogen. Overall, they're definitely an interesting case, and I think a generous representation of them is the C tier. Though, maybe if there's interest, I could just make a tier list going over all the cereals. Cinnamon rolls are a high calorie food with a sorry micronutrient profile. They have some cool nutrients like calcium and phosphorus. And I like what cinnamon has to offer, just not like this. But beyond that, cinnamon rolls are just fat, simple carbs, and added sugars. They're an easy choice to be the first of likely many residents of the F tier. Croissants are a higher calorie food with a cruddy micronutrient profile. They're not a bad source of protein and fiber, roughly 3 gram, as well as selenium and comparatively folate, but realistically they're mainly simple carbs with a surprising amount of added sugar and fat. Now, like bagels, they are commonly filled with other ingredients, and those can somewhat justify croissants as a method of delivery. But overall, croissants themselves don't offer what we're looking for in a breakfast, and I'm going to put them in the D tier. Fruit Danish is a high calorie food with a dismal micronutrient profile. Now, there are many Danish varieties, cheese, eggs, spinach, and custard to name a few, but the fruit kind seems to be the most popular. However, most commercial Danishes seem to not even use real fruit, instead opting for preserves or purees. And this results in the same sad story of simple carbs, added sugar, and unhelpful fats without having the decency to be nutritious or satiating. I'm going to put Danish in the F tier. Glazed donuts are a high calorie food with a disappointing micronutrient profile. And wow, there are so many different types of sugar-coated breakfast breads. Again, it's lots of calories from simple carbs, fats, and added sugars without any protein or fiber to help make the energy last. Hopefully, surprising no one, donuts are going in the F tier. Whole scrambled eggs are a lower calorie breakfast food with an excellent micronutrient profile. And can I just say, it's nice to finally have another real food. Eggs are among the best sources of very bioavailable protein, and they couple that with healthy fats to promote satiety to get you through the morning. They're the best source on this list of choline, which is used in neurotransmitter synthesis, and vitamin D, which improves calcium and phosphorus absorption. And they're among the best sources of selenium, vitamin B12, vitamin B2, vitamin B5, and vitamin A, as well as lutein and zeazanthin, non-provitonoids that function as antioxidants for eye health. Of all the traditional breakfast foods, nothing does nutrients and satiety quite like whole eggs, and I'm going to put them in the top tier. Egg whites are a very low calorie food with an extremely polarizing micronutrient profile. They're mainly just water and protein, giving them the highest protein per calorie on this list by a landslide. They're also a solid source of selenium and vitamin B2. Egg whites are great for people looking for a lot of protein, but for most, they're less good in practice when compared to whole eggs in regards to all of energy, satiety, and nutrients. Still, I'm going to put egg whites in the A tier. English muffins are an average calorie food with a middling micronutrient profile. They're higher than most breakfast foods in protein and fiber, about 3 g, and they're a good source of selenium. Many varieties are made of refined flour, but you can find whole grain types with some effort. They're a very middle-of the road choice for our breakfast goals that again depends a lot on what you put in it. In that regard, they're very similar to bagels by being a better bread-based breakfast. That's right, English muffins are going in the C tier. French toast is an average calorie breakfast food with a faulty micronutrient profile. Though this is another breakfast bread that can vary a bit. Its nutrients depend on the type of bread used and how much of the other ingredients like eggs, milk, butter, and cinnamon there is that variety and dairy often gives it a bit more of a complex nutrient profile containing some protein, fiber, and vitamin A. But beyond that, it's unsurprisingly mainly simple carbs and sugars that won't satisfy you as much as others. I'm putting French toast in the D tier. Corn grits are a low calorie food with a ghastly micronutrient profile to match the low calories. These are the numbers for when they're cooked and full of water. Corn is naturally not the most nutritious food, but it is rich in the carotenoids lutein and zeazanthin and several phenolic acids, and it is an option for those who need to remain gluten-free. But really, they're lacking in any nutritional substance. So, I'm going to put grits in the D tier. Hash browns are an average calorie food with a halfbaked micronutrient profile. They're the requisite breakfast potato dish that comes in many forms and they're all pretty similar. Hash browns are fairly fibrous, mainly in soluble fiber with a mild amount of vitamin E and potassium. And potatoes contain more complex carbs than all the breads, which is better for satiety and blood sugar. Unfortunately, they're most commonly deep fried and not the best fats. So, calling them innocent like regular potatoes would be a lie. While they're not as terrible as other carbforward foods, it still doesn't provide much of what makes a good breakfast. So, I'm putting hash browns in the C tier. All right, it's muffin time. Blueberry muffins, seemingly the most popular type, are a high calorie food with a mild micronutrient profile. This is another bread-based breakfast that can vary greatly depending on the ingredients, but they're usually made of all-purpose flour. They're a decent source of vitamin K, though most of the appeal of ingredients like fruits and nuts are only partially preserved and often overshadowed by everything else. The low protein, low fiber, high simple carbs, and sugar. A familiar story. I'm putting muffins in the F tier. Oatmeal with milk is a low calorie breakfast food with an outstanding micronutrient profile. I've paired it with milk since that's a pretty common combination, and I've already covered plain oats several times before. Oatmeal is well known for how satiating it is due to its relevant protein content and its high fiber content per calorie, notably the soluble fiber beta glucan, which aids with cholesterol. Oatmeal is among the best sources of manganesees, while milk pairs it with phosphorus, vitamin B12, and calcium. Oats are higher in resistant starch, which benefits gut health, and they're a more antioxidant-rich grain, notably containing many phenolic acids and the unique aaninthramides. For a breakfast food, it checks most of what we're looking for, specifically energy and satiety. And I'm going to put oatmeal in the A tier. Pancakes are an average calorie breakfast food with a pedestrian micronutrient profile. And this is another middle-of- the road grain-based dish. moderate protein and fiber content, a relevant amount of selenium, phosphorus, and calcium, but the bulk of it is non-nutritious or satiating simple carbohydrates. This is a staple, and I had to include it despite knowing that there wasn't much to say about it, at least when they're made traditionally. Alternatives like buckwheat pancakes or dedicated protein pancakes are growing more popular, and they have noticeably more to offer nutritionally. But typical pancakes, I'm going to put in the D tier. Spinach kiche is a higher calorie food with an impressive micronutrient profile. For those who have never had kiche, it's kind of like an egg pie containing eggs, milk, cheese, often meats like ham, or veggies like tomato, mushrooms, or seemingly the most popular, spinach. This is a nutritious combination of ingredients. Kiche is a genuine source of protein. It's the highest on this list of vitamin K, which is needed for blood clotting, and vitamin A, which is crucial for vision and immune function. and it's among the best sources of manganesees, vitamin B5, phosphorus, calcium, and choline. It is highly customizable to your goals and needs, and it is energizing and satiating, which is what we're looking for. I'm putting kiche in the A tier. Pork sausage is a higher calorie food with a substantial micronutrient profile. It is one of the few common meat breakfast items. Sausage is high in protein and high in fat, mainly monounsaturated and saturated fat, and its calories are far from being void of nutrients. It's the best source on this list of vitamin B12, which is needed for brain function and DNA synthesis. Vitamin B5, another of the metabolic B vitamins, and zinc, which is crucial for immune function and wound healing. And it's among the best sources of the other B vitamins, too. While that's all nice, breakfast sausage is almost exclusively a processed meat, cured, smoked, and full of additives. I can't exactly call it a healthy option despite the fact that it has a lot to offer on paper. Thus, I'm putting breakfast sausage in the C tier. Strawberry banana smoothie is a lowc calorie choice with a variable micronutrient profile. Seemingly the most popular type, but you can make smoothies out of most fruits, so I'm not going to sweat the details over all the varieties. And most fruit smoothies are just the fruits themselves and often milk or yogurt and maybe a sweetener like honey. Nutrients can vary, but it's mostly going to be sugar as that is the main macro in fruit, but it's not hard to thicken it with some fat and protein. So I'm going to put smoothies in the B tier. Beyond that, they're mainly refined carbs, but waffles have plenty of potential if made from whole grains. But your average waffle isn't doing you any favors, and I'm going to put those in the D tier. And lastly, yogurt with fruit is a low calorie food with a solid micronutrient profile. लव दिस शिट। क्योंकि भाई मजा आता है कि लोग आ रहे हैं। आई मेट अ पर्सन अ फ्यू डेज बैक जो मुझे बता रहा था ही लॉस्ट सो मच वेट बाय जस्ट बीइंग मोटिवेटेड बाय मी। एंड मैंने कहा भाई मैंने तो कुछ किया भी नहीं transcript: పంటకు కావలసిన ఎరువులన్నీ వేస్తున్నాం నీరు సరిగా ఇస్తున్నాం. మొక్కలు పచ్చగా ఉన్నాయి కానీ పూత రావడం లేదు. కాయ సరిగా పెరగడం లేదు. అంటే దీని సమస్య చాలాసార్లు న్యూట్రిషన్ బ్యాలెన్స్ లోపమే మరి అలాంటి సమయంలో ఉపయోగపడే మల్టీ న్యూట్రియంట్ సొల్యూషన్ గురించి ఈరోజు మాట్లాడుకుందాం. తెలుగు రైతులు ఛానల్ కు స్వాగతం. నేను మీ లక్ష్మీ నాగరాజు ఈరోజు వీడియోలో పంట పొలాలకు కావలసిన మల్టీ న్యూట్రియంట్స్ గురించి తెలుసుకుందాం. ఈ విలువైన ఇన్ఫర్మేషన్ కోసం వీడియో చివరి వరకు స్కిప్ చేయకుండా చూడండి. ఈ మల్టీ న్యూట్రిషన్ మార్కెట్ లో మాక్స్ పేరుతో లభిస్తుంది. ఇది ఒక సంపూర్ణమైన మైక్రో న్యూట్రియంట్స్ మిశ్రమం మొక్కలకు చిన్న మూతాదులో కావలసిన మరియు అవసరమైన అత్యంత కీలకమైన న్యూట్రిషన్లను ఒకేసారి అందిస్తుంది. ఇది ఒక ఎరువులా కాదు ఒక మూలకం లాగా కూడా కాదు. మొక్కలకు ఒక బ్యాలెన్స్ న్యూట్రిషన్ సపోర్ట్. మొక్కలకు న్యూట్రిషన్ ఎందుకు కీలకం. మొక్కలకు కావలసిన పోషకాలు రెండు రకాలుగా ఉంటాయి. ఒకటి మైక్రో న్యూట్రియంట్స్ఎన్పికే రూపంలో రెండవది మైక్రో న్యూట్రిషన్ ఇవి తక్కువ మోతాదులు అవసరం. ఎక్కువగా మనం యూరియా, డిఏపి, పొటాష్ వేస్తుంటాం. వీటితో పాటు మైక్రో న్యూట్రిషన్స్ వేయకపోతే పంట ఎదుగుదల ఆగిపోయి దిగుబడి తగ్గుతుంది. ఈ మైక్రో న్యూట్రియంట్స్ లో ఏముంటాయి? The scoop he used to measure the caffeine powder was actually meant for protein, not for a fine, potent stimulant. transcript: In September 1849, a woman named Harriet Tubman escaped slavery in Maryland and made her way north toward freedom. She traveled at night, hid during the day, and when food ran out, survived on what the forest offered. One of those offerings was a fruit most modern Americans have never tasted. It grew wild along the roots to freedom, hanging heavy on trees near riverbanks and forest edges. And for three crucial weeks every September, it provided calories, nutrition, and hope to people who had nothing else. The pawpaw azamina triloba is North America's largest edible native fruit. It tastes like a tropical blend of mango, banana, and pineapple with a custard-like texture that melts on your tongue. Nutritionally, it outperforms nearly every fruit in the modern supermarket. But walk into any grocery store in America today and you will not find it. Not because it does not grow here. Pawpo grows wild across 26 states from Florida to Ontario and from Nebraska to New York. And not because it tastes bad. Nearly everyone who tries pawpaw for the first time describes it as one of the best fruits they have ever eaten. The pawpaw disappeared because of a single technological shift that happened in the 1940s. One that changed American food forever and made fruits like pawpaw obsolete. This is the story of how refrigeration killed the most nutritious fruit in North America. Before Europeans arrived, the pawpaw was a staple food for dozens of indigenous nations. The Shauny even had an entire month in their calendar dedicated to poor poor harvest. The Palhatan word for the fruit asimin eventually became its scientific name. Archaeological evidence from Russell Cave in Alabama shows pawpaw seeds dating back 8,000 years. Indigenous communities did not just forage pawpaw. They cultivated them. They spread them. And they planted the best trees near their settlements. When Hernando Dotto traveled through the Mississippi Valley in 1541, his chronicler documented Native Americans growing pawpaw in managed groves. This was not wilderness food. It was agriculture. Early colonists adopted pawpaw immediately. It was abundant. It was free and it grew where European fruit trees struggled. George Washington loved pawpaw and served them chilled as dessert at Mount Vernon. Thomas Jefferson planted pawpaw trees at Montichello, listing papa acamina triloba among the fruits he cultivated personally. In 1806, Lewis and Clark ran out of provisions in what is now Missouri. William Clark wrote in his journal that they were entirely out of provisions and subsisting on poor pores. 3 days later, he wrote that they could live very well on the poor pores. The explorers did not just survive on pawpaw, they thrived on it. And nutritionally, pawpo is exceptional. A 100 g serving of pawpaw contains three times as much vitamin C as an apple, and two times as much as a banana. It has 10 times as much calcium as banana or apple, 20 to 70 times as much iron, and 4 to 20 times as much magnesium. Pawpaw protein contains all nine essential amino acids, exceeding apple in every one and matching or surpassing banana and orange in most. Research from Kentucky State University shows pawpaw has a superior fatty acid profile compared to banana with 40% monounsaturated fats, lower saturated fat, and better cardiovascular impact. Porpaw also contains acettogenins, plant compounds showing promise in laboratory studies for anti-cancer properties. Its bark, leaves, and twigs even contain natural insecticides, protecting the tree without human intervention. During the Great Depression, Poorpaw sustained thousands of rural families and earned the nickname poor man's banana. Soldiers in the Civil War, both Union and Confederate, foraged pawpaw to supplement their rations. Freedom seekers escaping slavery, also relied on poor paw while traveling the Underground Railroad North. The fruit ripened in September, peak season for escape attempts when nights grew longer and crops provided cover. Pawpaw was not just food. It was survival coded into the American landscape. So what happened? In 1938, a truck driver named Frederick McKinley Jones invented the first portable air cooling unit for trucks. Before this, refrigerated transport relied on melting ice packed around produce. Jones's invention changed everything. Trucks could suddenly maintain stable, cold temperatures for days, and the modern refrigerated truck was born. By 1940, commercial refrigerated shipping containers appeared. By 1950, refrigerated rail cars became standard. And by 1960, the cold chain, the system that keeps food cold from farm to table, became the backbone of American food distribution. Consumers gained fresh oranges from Florida in December, lettuce from California in February, and strawberries from Chile in January. But the cold chain had requirements to justify the cost of transport across thousands of miles. Fruit needed shelf life, at least 7 days, ideally 14. Apples last 2 to 4 weeks in cold storage. Bananas survive 7 to 14 days if picked green. Oranges can last 3 to 8 weeks. Pawpaw lasts 2 days, three if you are lucky. A ripe pawpaw bruises easily and continues ripening after harvest. Once ripe, it fermentss rapidly. Unripe pawpaw can be refrigerated for up to 2 weeks, but once they ripen, the clock starts. You have 48 hours before the fruit is past its prime. This is not a flaw. It is biology. Pawpaw evolved in North American forests where its consumers were local foxes, raccoons, and apossums. The fruit did not need to survive a 1,000-mile journey. It needed to survive 100 ft from tree to animal. But in 1950, the American food system stopped being local. Grocery chains centralized, distribution centers emerged, and food traveled farther. The cold chain could not accommodate poor poor. So poor poor was dropped. Not by decree, not by conspiracy, by logistics. By 1960, bananas imported from Ecuador had more shelf space in American grocery stores than pawpaw grown in American backyards. The system selected for durability, not nutrition. Poorpaw, which had sustained Native Americans for eight millennia, colonists for two centuries, and freedom seekers for decades, vanished from commerce. What did we lose? The average American eats 35 lbs of bananas per year, most traveling over 2,000 m. If pawpaw had remained in American orchards, we would eat local fruit with two times the vitamin C, 10 times the calcium, and 30 times the iron, without refrigerated container ships, burning fuel to cross oceans. Pawpo grows without pesticides, resists insects naturally, and serves as the exclusive host plant for the zebra swallowtail butterfly. When poor poor orchards disappeared, butterfly populations declined and an entire ecosystem felt the loss. Most Americans under 50 have never tasted pawpaw. They have never experienced a fruit that tastes tropical yet grows in their own climate. But pawpaw proves North America had that fruit all along. In 1990, Kirk Pompa launched the Pawpaw research program at Kentucky State University. Today, there are over 27 named cultivars. They will never survive a week in a grocery store. They thrive at farmers markets. In 2019, the Ohio Pawpaw Festival attracted over 10,000 people. Pawpaw is returning quietly. You can plant a pawpaw tree today. In 6 to 8 years, it will bear fruit. For the next 50 years, it will feed you without pesticides, refrigerated trucks, or global shipping. The same fruit that fed freedom seekers still grows wild across 26 states. It never disappeared from the land. It disappeared from our tables. Harriet Tubman did not know about cold chains. She knew about survival. And in September, Pawpaw was there. The trees are still there. The fruit still ripens. And after 70 years, we may finally be ready to remember what we lost. transcript: Here are the only 21 groceries you need to buy every week to save money and eat healthy. Bananas. Bananas are the ultimate budget friendly fruit and should be at the top of your weekly shopping list. They cost pennies per pound and provide natural energy from healthy starches and sugars. Plus, they're loaded with potassium, which supports heart health and muscle function. Green bananas contain prebiotic fibers that feed the good bacteria in your gut, promoting better digestion. To use this grocery hack, buy a bunch of bananas at different ripess levels. Eat the ripe ones first throughout the week and save the greener ones for later. You can slice them over oatmeal, add them to smoothies, or simply grab one as a quick snack. When ripe bananas start getting too brown, freeze them for smoothies or banana bread. The versatility and low cost make bananas an essential weekly purchase that stretches your food dollar further. Eggs. Eggs are nature's perfect protein and one of the most economical sources of nutrition you can buy. Each egg contains about 6 g of complete protein along with essential vitamins and minerals including vitamin D, B12, and selenium. The best part is eggs work for any meal of the day, not just breakfast. To maximize your egg budget, buy the largest carton you can afford and store them properly in the refrigerator where they'll stay fresh for weeks. Scramble them for breakfast, make hard-boiled eggs for snacks throughout the week, add them to fried rice, or use them in baking. The protein in eggs keeps you feeling full longer, which means you'll eat less throughout the day, saving even more money over time. This grocery staple is incredibly versatile and delivers exceptional nutritional value for just pennies per serving. Brown rice. Brown rice is a nutritional powerhouse that costs significantly less than most other grains when bought in bulk. Unlike white rice, brown rice retains its nutrient-rich bran and germ layers, providing more fiber, vitamins, and minerals that support overall health. A large bag can feed a family for weeks, making it an exceptional value. To maximize this grocery staple, cook brown rice in large batches and freeze portions in individual containers. This gives you the convenience of instant rice at a fraction of the cost. Brown rice pairs perfectly with stir fries, curries, beans, and vegetables, making it the foundation for countless budget friendly meals. You can also use leftover rice for fried rice bowls or mix it into soups for added texture and nutrition. The complex carbohydrates in brown rice provide sustained energy throughout the day, keeping hunger at bay and reducing the temptation to spend money on expensive convenience foods later in the day. Buying brown rice instead of instant flavored packets saves money while giving you control over sweetness and added ingredients. Dried beans. Dried beans are among the cheapest sources of protein and fiber available at any grocery store. A single bag costs just a couple dollars and expand significantly when cooked, providing numerous servings of plant-based protein. Beans contain both protein and fiber, which work together to keep you full and satisfied, reducing overall food consumption. To use this money-saving hack, soak dried beans overnight, then cook them in large batches. You can freeze beans in portions for quick use throughout the week. Add beans to soups, stews, tacos, salads, or mash them for homemade fried beans. The variety of beans available, including brack beans, pinto beans, kidney beans, and chickpeas, means you'll never get bored with your meals. Replacing meat with beans just once or twice per week can dramatically reduce your grocery bill while boosting your fiber intake and supporting digestive health. Chicken thighs. When it comes to affordable protein, chicken thighs are your best friend in the grocery store. They cost significantly less than chicken breasts, but actually have more flavor and stay juicier during cooking. Buying skin-on, bonein thighs gives you the lowest price, though they require a bit more preparation time. To maximize your chicken budget, buy family packs when they're on sale and freeze portions for future weeks. Chicken thighs can be baked, grilled, slowcooked, or pan fried, and work in virtually any recipe calling for chicken. The dark meat contains slightly more fat than chicken breast, but this fat carries flavor and helps you feel satisfied with smaller portions. You can remove the skin before cooking if you want to reduce fat content, or leave it on for crispy roasted chicken that rivals any restaurant dish. The bones can be saved to make homemade chicken stock, adding even more value to your purchase. Sweet potatoes. Sweet potatoes are nutritional superstars that remain affordable year round. They're loaded with vitamin A, fiber, and antioxidants that support eye health, immune function, and overall wellness. Unlike regular potatoes, sweet potatoes have a lower glycemic index, meaning they won't spike your blood sugar as dramatically. To use this budget vegetable, simply wash and pierce them with a fork, then bake at 400° for about 45 minutes until soft. You can eat them plain with a pad of butter, mash them as a side dish, slice them into fries, or cube them for roasting. Sweet potatoes also work beautifully in soups, stews, and even baked goods like muffins and brownies. Their natural sweetness means you can use less added sugar in recipes. The long shelf life means they won't spoil quickly in your pantry, making them a smart purchase that reduces food waste. Carrots. Carrots are one of the most versatile and budget friendly vegetables you can buy. They're available year round at low prices and stay fresh in the refrigerator for weeks. Carrots provide beta carotene, which your body converts to vitamin A, supporting vision health and immune function. A large bag of whole carrots costs less than baby carrots and provides more servings. To use this vegetable hack, wash and peel carrots, then cut them into sticks for snacking with hummus or ranch dip. Shred them for salads and sllo. Roast them with olive oil and seasonings, or add them to soups, stews, and stir fries. The natural sweetness of cooked carrots appeals even to picky eaters, making them an excellent way to increase vegetable consumption in your household. Raw carrots provide a satisfying crunch that can help curb cravings for expensive salty snacks later in the day. Cabbage. Cabbage is an incredibly underrated vegetable that provides enormous value for very little money. A single head of cabbage can feed a family multiple meals and cost just a couple dollars. Cabbage is rich in vitamin C, vitamin K, and beneficial plant compounds that support digestive health and may reduce inflammation. To use this budget hack, slice cabbage thinly for kleslaw, chop it for stir fries, add it to soups or stews, or roast wedges in the oven for a crispy side dish. Cabbage also makes an excellent base for homemade egg rolls or cabbage rolls stuffed with rice and meat. Both green and purple cabbage work interchangeably in most recipes, though purple cabbage adds beautiful color to salads and sllo. The hearty texture of cabbage means it holds up well in cooking and doesn't become mushy like some other vegetables. This cruciferous vegetable stores well in the refrigerator for weeks, making it a smart purchase that won't go to waste. Canned tomatoes. Canned tomatoes are a pantry staple that should be on every weekly shopping list. They cost just a dollar or two per can and form the base for countless budget friendly meals, including pasta sauces, chili, soups, and stews. Canned tomatoes are picked and processed at peak ripeness, which means they often contain more nutrients than fresh tomatoes that were picked early for shipping. To use this grocery hack, keep several cans in your pantry at all times so you can whip up a quick meal without an extra trip to the store. Crush whole tomatoes by hand for a rustic sauce, or blend them smooth for a more refined texture. Add canned tomatoes to rice dishes, curries, or use them as a base for homemade pizza sauce. The lycopine in tomatoes actually becomes more bioavailable when cooked, making canned tomatoes an even healthier choice than raw ones. Buying store-brand canned tomatoes instead of name brands saves additional money without sacrificing quality. Peanut butter. Peanut butter is one of the most affordable sources of protein and healthy fats available. A large jar costs just a few dollars and provides dozens of servings, making it an exceptional value. Peanut butter contains protein, fiber, and hearthealthy monounsaturated fats that keep you satisfied and energized for hours. Natural peanut butter with just peanuts and salt contains no added sugars or hydrogenated oils, making it the healthiest choice. Though conventional peanut butter works fine on a tight budget. The combination of protein and fat in peanut butter helps stabilize blood sugar, preventing the energy crashes that lead to poor food choices later in the day. Whole wheat pasta. Whole wheat pasta costs only slightly more than regular pasta, but provides significantly more fiber and nutrients that keep you full and satisfied longer. The extra fiber helps regulate digestion and blood sugar levels while providing more vitamins and minerals than refined white pasta. To use this budget hack, cook pasta according to package directions, but save some of the starchy cooking water to help sauce adhere better. Toss cooked pasta with olive oil, garlic, and vegetables for a simple meal. Add it to soups or stews, or use it in pasta salads for lunches throughout the week. Buying pasta in bulk when it's on sale and storing it in your pantry ensures you always have an inexpensive meal foundation available. Frozen mixed vegetables. Frozen vegetables are just as nutritious as fresh produce, but cost significantly less and last for months in your freezer without spoiling. The vegetables are flash frozen at peak ripeness, locking in vitamins and minerals. A large bag of frozen mixed vegetables provides numerous servings for just a few dollars. To maximize this grocery hack, keep several bags in your freezer for quick additions to any meal. Add frozen vegetables to soups, stews, stirfries, pasta dishes, or omelets without any thawing required. You can also microwave them as a simple side dish in just minutes. Buying frozen vegetables eliminates the guilt and waste of fresh produce that spoils before you can use it, making your food budget stretch further. Onions. Onions are one of the most essential flavorbuilding ingredients in cooking and they remain remarkably affordable year round. A bag of onions costs just a couple dollars and the individual onions last for weeks when stored in a cool, dry place. Onions contain beneficial compounds that support heart health and have anti-inflammatory properties. To use this vegetable foundation, sauteed diced onions as the base for soups, stews, sauces, and stir fries. Slice them for burgers and sandwiches, or caramelize them slowly for a sweet topping that enhances countless dishes. Garlic. Garlic is an inexpensive flavor powerhouse that transforms simple ingredients into delicious meals. A whole bulb of garlic costs less than a dollar and contains numerous individual cloves that pack intense flavor. Garlic has been used for centuries for its potential health benefits, including supporting immune function and heart health. To maximize this aromatic ingredient, buy whole bulbs rather than preminced garlic in jars, which cost more and has less flavor. Peel and mince fresh garlic cloves, then add them to virtually any savory dish, including pasta sauces, stir fries, roasted vegetables, soups, and marinades. Roasting whole cloves makes them sweet and spreadable, while raw garlic provides the most intense flavor and potential health benefits. Storing garlic in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight keeps it fresh for weeks, making it a pantry staple that never goes to waste. Canned tuna. Canned tuna is an incredibly affordable protein source that requires no cooking or preparation. A single can costs just a dollar or two and provides about 20 g of complete protein along with omega-3 fatty acids that support heart and brain health. To use this convenient protein, make classic tuna salad with mayonnaise and serve it on bread or crackers. Mix it into pasta salads. Add it to green salads for extra protein. Or make tuna patties by combining it with breadcrumbs and eggs, then pan frying until golden. Yogurt. Yogurt is a versatile dairy product that provides protein, calcium, and beneficial probiotics that support digestive health. Buying large containers of plain yogurt instead of individual flavored cups saves considerable money and allows you to control sweetness. To maximize this grocery staple, yeet yogurt for breakfast topped with fruit and granola. Use it as a base for smoothies, substitute it for sour cream and recipes, or use it in marinades for tender meat. Buying whole grain or whole wheat bread instead of white bread provides more fiber and nutrients that support sustained energy and digestive health. While the upfront cost may seem high, a single bottle lasts for weeks or months, making it very economical per use. Olive oil contains monounsaturated fats that can help reduce bad cholesterol levels when used in place of saturated fats. To maximize this pantry staple, use olive oil for sautéing vegetables, roasting meats and vegetables, making salad dressings and marinades, or drizzling over finished dishes for added flavor. Cheese.
